commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level-0 rename, greeting, and exit

commitResults.messageBody: Record the repository remote and the commit, tag, and push steps so future increments follow the course submission requirements consistently.
Read commands in a loop, echo ordinary input, and stop with a farewell when the user enters bye.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level-2 in-memory task storage and listing

commitResults.messageBody: Store completion state alongside each task so the mark command can update an item and subsequent list output can distinguish completed tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for unmarking completed tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Reset the selected task's completion flag so users can reverse accidental or outdated done statuses and see the change in later list output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent task data with a Task class
commitResults.messageBody: Keep each task's description and completion state together so marking, unmarking, and display behavior are encapsulated instead of coordinated across parallel arrays.

Record exact command-output cases in a Markdown test plan and provide a Java 25 runner that prints console transcripts, compares output, and stops with expected-versus-actual diagnostics on the first failure.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require UI tests after application changes
commitResults.messageBody: Direct coding agents to review the UI test plan after each application update, invoke the project test-ui skill, and stop with expected-versus-actual diagnostics on failure.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add typed todo, deadline, and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Parse the three Level-4 command formats, retain date and time details as strings, display task-type icons, and cover the new console behavior in the UI test plan.
Move todo, deadline, and event formatting and timing data into focused Task subclasses so Twizzy can handle every task polymorphically through its Task array.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle empty todos and unknown commands
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce a checked TwizzyException with corrective messages and verify that rejected inputs do not corrupt task-list state or stop later commands.
Give specific corrective errors for malformed tasks and task selections, preserve application state after rejected commands, and require interleaved edge-case UI coverage in future increments.

Require complete delimiter tokens so lookalike text cannot be misparsed, keep the capacity error actionable, eliminate serialization lint warnings, and add regression coverage for delimiter boundary cases.
Replace the fixed array and manual task count with a dynamically sized collection so indexed insertion, access, and the upcoming deletion operation use the Collections API.
Remove tasks by one-based list number through ArrayList, report the removed task and remaining count, preserve list renumbering, and cover successful and invalid deletion flows in UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent command keywords with an enum
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize the finite command vocabulary and argument rules in CommandType, dispatch commands through enum cases, and add UI regression coverage for keyword-prefix and unexpected-argument inputs.

Save each task-list mutation to a readable local file so tasks and completion state survive application restarts. Extend the UI test runner with isolated restart scenarios to verify persistence without cross-test state leakage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7 for persistent task storage

commitResults.messageBody: Represent deadline and event dates as LocalDate values so invalid calendar dates are rejected and valid dates display consistently. Persist dates in ISO format and expand UI coverage for formatting, leap years, invalid inputs, and restarts.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8 for parsed task dates

commitResults.messageBody: Move console interaction, command parsing, and task collection operations out of Twizzy so each component has one clear responsibility while preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Give Twizzy a playful product voice
commitResults.messageBody: Replace generic chatbot responses with a concise twin-like personality while keeping instructions clear. Rewrite the starter README and user guide so the project is presentable and accurately documents setup, commands, persistence, and errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize Twizzy classes into a package
commitResults.messageBody:
The application classes sit in the default package, which does not scale
well as the project gains more components.

Move all production classes into the twizzy package and update the
documentation and UI test runner to use the resulting entry point.

Keeping one package is sufficient for the current small application while
leaving clear boundaries for later subpackages.
Integrate the A-Packages increment so master uses the twizzy package.
Add the supplied Gradle build infrastructure for the A-Gradle increment.

The supplied Gradle template launches Duke and names the runnable archive
duke.jar, which does not match this project.

Configure the application plugin to launch twizzy.Twizzy and name the
fat JAR twizzy.jar so Gradle builds an artifact that users can run.
Integrate Gradle support configured for the Twizzy application.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add parser and storage unit tests
commitResults.messageBody:
The parser and storage code contain the most important validation and
persistence behavior, but they lacked isolated automated coverage.

Add JUnit tests for successful and rejected parsing, task index validation,
and task storage round trips, missing files, and corrupt data.
Integrate focused JUnit coverage for parser and storage behavior.

Users cannot locate a task without scanning the whole task list.

Add a find command that returns description matches in their original order,
ignoring letter case. Validate that a keyword is present and cover normal,
empty-result, and invalid-input behavior in the automated tests.
Integrate the Level-9 keyword search command and its test coverage.

Coding-standard checks depended on manual review, making style regressions easy
to miss.

Configure Gradle Checkstyle for the applicable SE-EDU rules and correct the
reported spacing and acronym-naming issues so main and test code pass.
Integrate automated Checkstyle checks and their compliant formatting fixes.

The task manager is only accessible through standard input, which makes
interactive task management less approachable.

Add an FXML-based JavaFX chat window that submits commands to Twizzy's
existing parser, task list, and storage. Keep the console interface for
regression testing and provide a launcher for JavaFX classpath compatibility.
Integrate the JavaFX GUI and shared command-response support.

Assert that TaskList callers pass an index for an existing task before accessing or removing it.

The parser validates user-supplied indices first, so a failed assertion now identifies an internal caller that violated this boundary instead of treating the condition as ordinary user input.

Derive command and marker substring boundaries from their named constants instead of hard-coded character counts.

This keeps parser behavior unchanged while making the relationship between each command token and its extracted text clear, and prevents a keyword rename from silently invalidating an offset.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use a stream to find matching tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Express the find operation as a filter over the task collection followed by collection into an ordered list.

The stream preserves the existing encounter order and applies the same case-insensitive predicate, while making the filtering intent more direct.
Merge the verified A-Assertions increment.
Merge the verified A-CodeQuality increment.
Merge the verified A-Streams increment.

Allow users to defer an active task until a future date and inspect deferred tasks separately.

Snoozed tasks are excluded from normal list and find results so the task numbers shown to users remain valid for later actions. The storage format records the snooze end date while accepting existing task files without that field.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve GUI navigation and command guidance
commitResults.messageBody:
Allow users to scroll back through chat history while still scrolling to new messages automatically.

Add a help command and first-use guidance so customers can discover command syntax without guessing. Document the Gradle resource setup required for direct GUI launches in IntelliJ.
